intro: Village Roll Call uses one Twitch Channel Points reward for one check-in per viewer per calendar day. Monthly rankings use check-in count, then earliest first check-in as the tie breaker.

sections.title: 1. Create and connect the reward
sections.description: Create one Streamer.bot-owned Twitch reward named Daily Check-In. Enable Skip Reward Queue, copy its Reward ID, and keep the existing Twitch Reward Redemption trigger on THSV Twitch - Intake.

sections.title: 2. Check-in messages
sections.description: Successful check-ins show the viewer's monthly count and rank. Repeat redemptions never increase the score.

sections.title: 3. Monthly winner
sections.description: The previous month is archived and announced on the first Twitch stream-online or valid check-in event in the new month.

sections.title: 4. Optional OBS card
sections.description: The hosted browser source briefly shows a bounded leaderboard after each successful check-in. Use Send preview card before going live.

sections.title: Privacy and storage
sections.description: Stores stable Twitch user IDs, current display names, daily/monthly check-in counters, and a bounded redemption replay list in private atomic add-on state.
sections.notice: No separate Streamer.bot import or direct trigger is required. Simulated redemptions preview the card but never change scores. This add-on stores no reward input, chat text, OAuth tokens, or hard-coded file paths.
